# Discharges

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Planned discharges and departures, blocked releases first.

## What is on the screen

1. Discharges today. Held up, confirmed, expected, and discharged in the last day.
2. Held up first. Discharges with something in the way come first. Open one to see what is blocking it and the bed release.
3. Held up by barrier. What is holding discharges up, counted by barrier.
4. Print list. A paper copy of the list for the ward or the bed meeting.

## Jobs done here

- Clear a held-up discharge. Open Discharges, where held-up discharges come first. Open one to see what is blocking it and the bed release, and update the barrier once it is sorted.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
